features.name: Trigger respins

features.name: Framed free spins
features.description: 3–5 bonus symbols award 10–20 free spins with framed positions.

review:
A 20-liner that moves from a coastal base game to a battlefield bonus. Two bonus symbol types – regular and Magnetic – and when two of either land, they lock and the rest respins for a shot at the third.

Three, four or five bonus symbols give 10, 15 or 20 free spins, with frames marking where they landed, and Magnetic Bonuses pulling features towards them. That trigger respin adds real near-miss tension. Up to 5,000x, 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
